mutants.replacement: export function headings(text){const out=[];let fenced=false;for(const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)){if(/^\s*`{3}/.test(line)){fenced=!fenced;continue;}const m=/^(#{1,6}) +(.+)$/.exec(line);if(m){const title=m[2].replace(/ *#+ *$/,'').trim();if(title)out.push({level:m[1].length,title});}}return out;}export function anchors(items){const seen=new Map();return items.map(item=>{const base=item.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 -]/g,'').trim().replace(/ +/g,'-')||'section';const n=seen.get(base)||0;seen.set(base,n+1);return {...item,id:base+(n?'-'+n:'')};});}
